integrity: All formulas and code are explicitly included; symbolic and numerical diagnostics are reproducible but do not replace the analytical uniqueness proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact classical four-state one-defect ring; no quantum-coherent sector, arbitrary disorder pattern, or larger cycle claim. Asymptotics are weak- and strong-defect limits in this fixed finite ring.
title: A unique spectral underdamping transition on a one-defect four-site stochastic ring
